body.name: Factorized separator priority/count handle
body.construction: Starting from a nice decomposition \(\mathcal T\), index each bag message by the relative order of active priorities, selected or unselected labels, higher-priority domination bits, the tag pattern, and a truncated \(z\)-count polynomial. Represent each order-chamber conditional density by an exact factorized arithmetic circuit over rational coefficients and bag-priority variables; seek an equivalence relation or circuit-normalization rule under which introduce, edge, forget-integration, join, and coefficient-extraction operations remain executable in size \(2^{O(w\log(w+1))}\operatorname{poly}(n,b)\).
